patch.explanation: Removed the erroneous UNION ALL that duplicated rows. The original model selected all customers and then UNION ALL the same source filtered to `c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'`, which re‑added those rows, causing 337 duplicate `customer_key` values and failing the uniqueness check. By keeping only the single SELECT (which already includes all rows), we preserve the required columns and types while ensuring each `customer_key` appears only once.
